summary: PCB Bancorp filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that its board approved a share repurchase program on September 23, 2026, authorizing up to 700,000 common shares. Repurchases may occur via open market, block, or privately negotiated transactions, with timing and price at company discretion, through September 22, 2027, and may be modified or suspended without notice. The company intends to use a Rule 10b5-1 plan administered by an independent broker. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Watch execution pace and capital ratio impact.
